run_grpc_server: run the asyncio gRPC route guide server on port 50051
get_feature_at_point: get the feature at a given latitude and longitude point from the route guide database
calculate_distance_between_points: calculate the haversine distance in meters between two geographic points
list_features_in_rectangle: list all features within a rectangular geographic bounding box defined by two corner points
record_route_summary: record a route by streaming points and return a summary with point count, feature count, distance, and elapsed time
